method: For 31 countries, each component's 2022-Aug 2026 total in site/data.json (EUR bn, central and range, same sign as data.json) was compared with an independent primary source downloaded on 2026-10-17: Kiel Ukraine Support Tracker Release 31 (aid), Eurostat Comext and UN Comtrade reporter data with HS-chapter breakdowns (trade with Russia), CREA fossil tracker API (fuel), Eurostat bop_its6_det (services), UNHCR population API (refugee counts) with national budget figures, and B4Ukraine/KSE reports (company taxes). Import checks are converted from CIF to FOB (x0.945) because the pipeline now does the same. 2026 trade = Jan-Aug actual for EU reporters, otherwise 2025 x 8/12. Verdict "ok" = check inside our range (3-5% tolerance for exchange-rate and concept differences); "adjust" = outside, with a corrected range; "unverifiable" = no independent series, with a worst-case range whose bounds are the plausible extremes on both sides (always wide enough to contain our range). Notes mark values that are inside the range but biased. Audited against data.json generated 2026-10-18 (file sha256 0f0b5f0377f9), which changed while the audit ran. Scripts and downloads: working/audit/.
